pages.text: Use Carry On’s pickup gesture on ordinary container cargo permitted by its configuration. With the default sneak-use gesture, pickup is tried before wagon unloading.$(br2)Dedicated parts such as stools and mats use their own fitting/removal interactions. Recover the whole wagon with a carpenter’s hammer.

Use an empty cargo slot while carrying a permitted block to load it with its contents. Wagon placement rules still apply. Use an empty stool while carrying an entity to seat it if clearance allows.$(br2)Custom Carry On keys remain separate from sneak-unloading. Maids still follow their riding-task rules.
